Your hardship requests: Our records show you called us on June 18 and June 30 about hardship options. Your June 18 request is logged as pending review. We found no return call or other response to either contact in our records.

Hardship options: We have several options for customers facing hardship:
- Payment date shift: moves your due date by up to 10 days within the same billing cycle, with no fee. It is available once per 12-month period.
- Reduced-payment plan: lowers your monthly payment for up to 3 months and extends your loan term. It requires supervisor approval.
- Interest-only or fee-deferral period: defers principal payments for up to 2 months. It requires supervisor approval.
- Full forbearance: pauses all payments for up to 60 days. It requires manager approval.

The reduced-payment, deferral and forbearance options are available, pending review. None has been approved for your account, and we cannot confirm any plan until the required approval is logged.
